lessons.key: weak_test::when a criterion lists alternative input sources fallback chain give each alternative its own asserted case one green case leaves the others unpinned
lessons.text: When a criterion lists alternative input sources (fallback chain), give each alternative its own asserted case; one green case leaves the others unpinned.

lessons.key: weak_test::when a criterion says a state is discarded test the round trip change away and back masking it against the current value passes a one way test
lessons.text: When a criterion says a state is discarded, test the round trip (change away and back); masking it against the current value passes a one-way test.

lessons.key: ac_gap::a setting shown on both car and phone needs a proof for each surface the phone list is built separately from choices
lessons.text: A setting shown on both car and phone needs a proof for each surface; the phone list is built separately from CHOICES.

lessons.key: weak_test::a does not react to x failing check must make x fail in the walk observing the happy path proves nothing
lessons.text: A 'does not react to X failing' check must make X fail in the walk; observing the happy path proves nothing.

lessons.key: ac_gap::a retry forever loop needs its trigger narrowed to the errors a retry can cure list the excluded error codes in the spec
lessons.text: A retry-forever loop needs its trigger narrowed to the errors a retry can cure; list the excluded error codes in the spec.
